answer: Basically following the rule of selecting I used in the previous section: always choosing warmer, brighter, lighter colors.

There isn't really a way to - that's like asking which way to maximize a coin toss. What I did was kind of tried to stick with one pattern (eventually) either all right squares or back and forth. Because I figured if I stuck to one side I'd have something around 50%. But if I tried to go back and forth, I might miss them all. I counted the right and wrong answers in sets of 10, and both all right and switching were coming up around 50%, so I figured that was the best I was gonna get.
